notes: Variant WLC.JOB.30.22.v002 is underdetermined and the projection carries the base reading r00-base for s010; the ASV's *in the storm* is compatible with the retained reading, so no new textual decision is made here (rules 9 and 53).
The italic *upon it* supplies a preposition and an object pronoun the Hebrew never writes and is one `added` unit (rules 30 and 44).
The causative *causest ... to ride* heads on the second verb, which carries the lexeme (rule 44).
